Key Part Sub-assemblies & Features
  • Bores 1, 2, 3: 3x Fastener pilot screw bosses with counterbores (Section W-W)
  • Snaps 1, 2, 3, 4: 4x Cantilever retention snap latches on housing perimeter (Detail N)
  • Mounting Ears 1-4: 4x Outer chassis mounting flanges with through-holes Ø4.7mm
  • Connector Interface: 5-Pin automotive sealed shroud with 2.5mm / 5.0mm pitch grid
  • Perimeter Gasket Seal: Continuous 0.9mm lip for environmental protection
  • Branding: Embossed 'saia-burgess' logo on primary gear hub
Engineering Verification Results Score: 100%
✓ All 5 automated engineering sanity checks passed successfully:
  • Hole Geometry Check: Pilot bore Ø2.6mm is strictly smaller than counterbore Ø3.3mm (Balloon #770 vs #774).
  • Connector Pitch Symmetry: Outer pins symmetric at 5.0mm (Balloons #501, #502); inner pins symmetric at 2.5mm (Balloons #503, #504).
  • GD&T Syntax Verification: Feature control frame [Position | 0.05 | Datum Y3] conforms to ISO 1101.
  • Snap-fit Clearance Check: Retention window height (5.3mm) cleanly clears mating latch height (4.4mm) (Balloons #760 vs #750).
  • Tolerance Sanity Check: All 45 dimension tolerances are non-negative and within ISO precision bounds.
